query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Use GitHub to inspect accessible repositories and branches, fetch repository files, update multiple repository files, create a public static preview repository, enable GitHub Pages, and commit generated content/configuration files.
query_ground_truth.query: list repositories and branches on GitHub
query_ground_truth.intent: Retrieve a list of accessible GitHub repositories and their corresponding branches.

request.query: list repositories and branches on GitHub

results.use_case: list repositories and branches on GitHub
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if repository coordinates or access are uncertain)] [Prerequisite]: Validate visibility and capture default branch using GITHUB_GET_A_REPOSITORY (separate auth failures from not-found before listing).
[Required] [Step 1]: List branches using GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES (collect branch name and tip commit identifier; response items may be nested).
[Optional (if branch count may exceed one page)] [Next Step]: Paginate using GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES (use per_page up to 100; increment page; stop when a page is short/empty).
[Optional (if confirming a specific branch tip or ref)] [Next Step]: Fetch branch metadata using GITHUB_GET_A_BRANCH and/or verify an exact ref using GITHUB_GET_A_REFERENCE (use heads/<branch>).

[Fallback (if 404/validation errors suggest wrong coordinates)] [Fallback]: Discover the correct repository using GITHUB_FIND_REPOSITORIES, then retry GITHUB_GET_A_REPOSITORY and GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES with corrected inputs.
known_pitfalls: [GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES] per_page max 100; without pagination you can miss branches on large repositories.
[GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES] Items may appear under data.details; parsing a different path can look like zero branches.
[GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES] Missing required inputs can raise an invalid-request error indicating owner/repo fields are absent.
[GITHUB_GET_A_REPOSITORY] 401 vs 403/404 can be ambiguous (bad credentials vs restricted/private vs wrong coordinates); validate before concluding the repo is missing.
[GITHUB_GET_A_REFERENCE] Ref must be heads/<branch>; using a bare branch name can 404.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Parse branch names and tip commit identifiers from a nested GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES response.
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
res, err = run_tool("GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES", {"owner":"OWNER","repo":"REPO","per_page":100})
if err: raise RuntimeError(err)
items = (res.get("data") or {}).get("details") or []
rows = [(b.get("name"), (b.get("commit") or {}).get("sha")) for b in items]
```

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Paginate GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES and collect branch names.
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
names=[]
page=1
while True:
  r,e = run_tool("GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES", {"owner":"OWNER","repo":"REPO","per_page":100,"page":page})
  if e: raise RuntimeError(e)
  ds=(r.get("data") or {}).get("details") or []
  if not ds: break
  names += [b.get("name","") for b in ds]
  if len(ds) < 100: break
  page += 1
```

GITHUB_LIST_BRANCHES.description: List branches in a GitHub repository. Returns branch names, commit information, and protection status. Use this action when you need to retrieve all branches in a repository, optionally filtered by protection status. This is useful for identifying available branches, checking which branches are protected, or preparing to create pull requests.

page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see 'Using pagination in the REST API'.

repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

per_page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see 'Using pagination in the REST API'.

protected.description: Setting to `true` returns only branches protected by branch protections or rulesets. When set to `false`, only unprotected branches are returned. Omitting this parameter returns all branches.

GITHUB_GET_A_REPOSITORY.description: Retrieves detailed information about an existing and accessible GitHub repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository, without the `.git` extension. This field is case-insensitive.

owner.description: The username of the account that owns the repository. This field is case-insensitive.

GITHUB_GET_A_BRANCH.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specified branch within a GitHub repository.

repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

branch.description: The name of the branch. Cannot contain wildcard characters. To use wildcard characters in branch names, use [the GraphQL API](https://docs.github.com/graphql). If 'HEAD' is provided, it will be resolved to the repository's default branch.
